final: SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_zone_ratio, COUNT(*) as zone_count, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM (SELECT step1.zoneref, step1.insurstat, step1.avg_ratio, step1.record_count, step1.avg_ratio - step2.avg_of_avg_ratio as difference FROM (SELECT sm.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(CASE WHEN sm.geomdeltamm != 0 AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / sm.geomdeltamm ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM scanmesh sm JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sm.zoneref, s.insurstat) step1 JOIN (SELECT s.insurstat, AVG(CASE WHEN sm.geomdeltamm != 0 AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / sm.geomdeltamm ELSE NULL END) as avg_of_avg_ratio FROM scanmesh sm JOIN sites s ON sm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat) step2 ON step1.insurstat = step2.insurstat WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.avg_of_avg_ratio) GROUP BY insurstat
